# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(ggthemes)
library(mclogit)
library(nnet)
library(parameters)
library(DirichletReg) 
```

# Compiling datasets 

Trajectory level

```{r}
loadData <- function(path, group, model) {
  df <- read.csv(path)
  df$group <- group # Keeping track of experimental condition 
  df$model <- model # Keeping track of model zero-shot or fine-tuned 
  df
}

control_low  <- loadData("control_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "zero_shot") 
control_medium    <- loadData("control_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "zero_shot")
control_random   <- loadData("control_random/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "random", "zero_shot")
control_deceptive   <- loadData("control_deceptive/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "deceptive", "zero_shot")

avoid_low         <- loadData("avoid_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
avoid_medium      <- loadData("avoid_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")

ft_control_low    <- loadData("ft_control_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_control_medium <- loadData("ft_control_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_low      <- loadData("ft_avoid_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_medium   <- loadData("ft_avoid_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")


full_data <- rbind(
  control_low, control_medium, control_random, control_deceptive,
  avoid_low, avoid_medium,
  ft_control_low, ft_control_medium, ft_avoid_low, ft_avoid_medium
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coin_and_goal = as.integer(reached_goal + coin_collected == 2),
    goal_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 1 & coin_collected == 0, 1, 0)),
    coin_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 0 & coin_collected == 1, 1, 0)),
    grid_size = as.factor(grid_size),
    density = as.factor(density)
  )

rm(control_low, control_medium, control_random, control_deceptive, 
   avoid_low, avoid_medium,
   ft_control_low, ft_control_medium, ft_avoid_low, ft_avoid_medium)

head(full_data)
```

Grid level

```{r}
control_low_grid  <- loadData("control_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "zero_shot") 
control_medium_grid    <- loadData("control_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "zero_shot")
control_random_grid   <- loadData("control_random/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "random", "zero_shot")
control_deceptive_grid   <- loadData("control_deceptive/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "deceptive", "zero_shot")
avoid_low_grid         <- loadData("avoid_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
avoid_medium_grid      <- loadData("avoid_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
ft_control_low_grid    <- loadData("ft_control_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_control_medium_grid <- loadData("ft_control_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_low_grid      <- loadData("ft_avoid_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_medium_grid   <- loadData("ft_avoid_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
full_data_grid <- rbind(
  control_low_grid, control_medium_grid, control_random_grid, control_deceptive_grid,
  avoid_low_grid, avoid_medium_grid,
  ft_control_low_grid, ft_control_medium_grid, ft_avoid_low_grid, ft_avoid_medium_grid
  ) 
rm(control_low_grid, control_medium_grid, control_random_grid, control_deceptive_grid, 
   avoid_low_grid, avoid_medium_grid,
   ft_control_low_grid, ft_control_medium_grid, ft_avoid_low_grid, ft_avoid_medium_grid)
head(full_data_grid)
```

Subsetting data for this specific round of analyses 

```{r}
traj_df <- full_data %>% 
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls"), 
         !(model == "fine_tuned" & reasoning_effort == "medium")) %>%
  mutate( # Ordering factors for mdl fitting 
    trajectory_category = fct_relevel(trajectory_category, "base"),
    grid_size = factor(grid_size,
                       levels = c("7", "9", "11"),
                       labels = c("Grid size 7", "Grid size 9", "Grid size 11"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
    density = factor(density,
                     levels = c("0","0.2","0.4","0.6"),
                     ordered = TRUE),
    group = if_else(reasoning_effort == "medium",
                    paste(group, reasoning_effort, sep = "_"), group),
    group = if_else(model == "fine_tuned",
                    paste(group, model, sep = "_"), group)
  )

grid_df <- full_data_grid %>%
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls"), !model == "fine_tuned") %>%
  mutate( # Ordering factors for mdl fitting 
    trajectory_category = fct_relevel(trajectory_category, "base"),
    grid_size = factor(grid_size,
                       levels = c("7", "9", "11"),
                       labels = c("Grid size 7", "Grid size 9", "Grid size 11"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
    density = factor(density,
                     levels = c("0","0.2","0.4","0.6"),
                     ordered = TRUE)
  )

file_output <- "overall"
```

```{r}
unique(traj_df$group)

traj_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_grids = n_distinct(grid_key)
    )
```

# Success

```{r}
grid_success_summary <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(group, grid_size, density) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_goal = mean(goal_only),
    se_goal = sd(goal_only)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_coin = mean(coin_only),
    se_coin = sd(coin_only)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_both = mean(coin_and_goal),
    se_both = sd(coin_and_goal)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(group,grid_size, density),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric,
                    levels = c("both", "coin", "goal")),
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("control", "control_medium", "control_fine_tuned", "deceptive",
                              "random","avoid","avoid_medium", "avoid_fine_tuned"))
    )

grid_success_raw <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(group, grid_size, density , grid_key) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_goal = mean(goal_only),
    mean_coin = mean(coin_only),
    mean_both = mean(coin_and_goal)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(group, grid_size, density, grid_key),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric,
                    levels = c("goal", "coin", "both")),
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("control", "control_medium", "control_fine_tuned", "deceptive",
                              "random","avoid","avoid_medium", "avoid_fine_tuned"))
  )

p1 <- ggplot(grid_success_summary, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = grid_success_raw,
    aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = group),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.1, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(density~grid_size,
             labeller = labeller(
             density = function(x) paste0("Density: ", x))
             ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("both", "coin", "goal"),
    labels = c(both = "Coin and terminal", coin = "Coin only",  goal = "Terminal only")
  ) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3594cc", "#8cc5e3", "#ea801c", "#f0b077")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#c8c8c8", "#f0c571", "#59a89c", "#0b81a2",
               "#e25759", "#9d2c00", "#7E4794", "#36b700"),
    limits = c("control", "control_medium", "control_fine_tuned", "deceptive",
               "random","avoid","avoid_medium", "avoid_fine_tuned"),  
    labels = c("Baseline - low reasoning", "Baseline - medium reasoning",
               "Baseline - fine tuned", "Deceptive - low reasoning", 
               "Baseline - random agent", "Avoid - low reasoning", 
               "Avoid - medium reasoning", "Avoid - fine tuned")  
  ) +
  labs(
    # title = "Task Success by Grid Size and Density",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Task success",
    fill = "Experimental condition"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
  )

ggsave(
  file.path("figures", file_output, "success_plot1.png"),
  p1, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 600
)

p1 
```

## Baseline: all groups vs. random 

```{r}
success_mdl1 <- traj_df %>%
  filter(!group %in% c("avoid","avoid_medium","avoid_fine_tuned")) %>%
  mutate(group = relevel(factor(group), ref = "random")) %>%
  glmer(
    coin_and_goal ~ grid_size + density + group + coin_detour_distance + start_to_goal_via_coin_distance + (1 | grid_key),
    data = .,
    family = binomial(),
    control = glmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa')
  )

summary(success_mdl1)
```

```{r}
    data = .,

  )

summary(success_mdl2)
```

## Baseline low vs avoid low 

```{r}
baseline_success <- traj_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("control","control_medium")) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(group == "control_medium", "control", "control")
  ) %>%
  rename(success = coin_and_goal) %>%
  select(group, reasoning_effort, grid_key, success)
  
avoid_success <- traj_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("avoid","avoid_medium")) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(group == "avoid_medium", "avoid", "avoid")
  ) %>%
  rename(success = goal_only) %>%
  select(group, reasoning_effort, grid_key, success)

success_df <- rbind(baseline_success, avoid_success)

compare_success_mdl1 <- success_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = relevel(factor(group), ref = "control"),
    reasoning_effort = relevel(factor(reasoning_effort), ref = "low")
    ) %>%
  glmer(
    success ~ group + reasoning_effort + (1 | grid_key),
    data = .,
    family = binomial(),
    control = glmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa')
  )

summary(compare_success_mdl1)
```

# Action accuracy 

```{r}
grid_accuracy_summary <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_goal = mean(action_accuracy),
    se_goal = sd(action_accuracy)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(group),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("control", "control_medium","deceptive","random","avoid","avoid_medium"))
    )

grid_accuracy_raw <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(group, grid_key) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_goal = mean(action_accuracy)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(group, grid_key),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("control", "control_medium","deceptive","random","avoid","avoid_medium"))
  )

p3 <- ggplot(grid_accuracy_summary, aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = grid_accuracy_raw,
    aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.15, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("control", "control_medium", "deceptive", "random"),
    labels = c("Collect - low reasoning", "Collect - medium reasoning",
               "Deceptive - low reasoning", "Baseline - random agent")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#2c6fb0", "#7aa8d4", "#7E4794","#b0b0b0"),
    limits = c("control", "control_medium", "deceptive", "random")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Action accuracy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path("figures", file_output, "accuracy_plot1.png"),
  p3, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600
)

p3
```
